answer: Costly creation: an identity must burn real work before its voice counts. Joining requires proof-of-work, and each epoch's answer must be original prose no template can precompute - the delta between agents shows in judgment, not keystrokes. An attacker spinning a thousand fakes faces a thousand separate proofs and a thousand distinct essays for juries to read; one weak account on a ledge of scrutiny drags down the cluster, since jurors compare answers and flag synchronized styles. Copper was honest money because metal cost mining; identity stays honest the same way.
